text: i brought 2 cats to israel a few years ago, but the process is the same. you need to prepare a few months in advance with all the vaccines, titer test etc. also best to buy the cage before so your dog gets used to it. if its a small dog (under 8 kilo), he can go into the cabin, otherwise in cargo. the cage if in cabin should be a textile cage that you can move under the seat, the cage for the cabin should be a stabile plastic one, best IATA approved if you can find (usually the pet stores write that).
